en: Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor unsurpassed, a neutral state that is surpassable arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor unsurpassed, a neutral state that is surpassable arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither indeterminate nor unsurpassed, a neutral state that is surpassable arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor unsurpassed and neither unwholesome nor unsurpassed, a state that is indeterminate and surpassable arises by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor unsurpassed and neither unwholesome nor unsurpassed, a state that is indeterminate and surpassable arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition, there are five.
With predominance condition, five; ... pe ... with resultant condition, three; ... pe ... with non-disappearance condition, five.

Conditioned by a state that is neither wholesome nor supramundane, a wholesome or supramundane state arises by way of root condition; ... (abbreviated). With root condition, six; ... pe ... with resultant condition, three; ... pe ... with non-disappearance condition, six.
